title: Alcatraz Visit + Self-Guided E-Bike Tour
includes: Round-trip ferry and Alcatraz admission ticket, including a 2.5-hour self-guided audio tour
Self-guided audio walking tour available in multiple languages
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Comfortable shoes and clothes, water and sunscreen are recommended; dress in layers as weather is likely to change quickly
For electric bikes, full-day equals life of 1 battery, approximately 20-35 miles (32-56km) depending on use
Please plan on a 3-hour Alcatraz Island tour experience, including roundtrip boat time.

Each ferry ride, the departure to Alcatraz Island from San Francisco and the return ferry to Pier 33 Alcatraz Landing from the Island, takes about fifteen (15) minutes. You can stay on Alcatraz Island as long as you like, but please plan for three (3) hours to enjoy the Cellhouse Audio Tour, view the exhibit, and explore the Island. It is recommended that you arrive at least forty-five (45) minutes prior to your departure time.
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: Combine a visit to Alcatraz Island with a self-guided electric bike ride along San Francisco’s waterfront. Explore the legendary prison, then cruise iconic sights and enjoy stunning views at your own pace with an electric bike!
